data.narrative:
Zettascale is a seed-stage semiconductor company founded by Elias Almqvist (CEO) and Prithvi Raj (CTO), having raised $3M+. The valuation universe comprises 11 peers in the Chips & Semiconductors sector, including 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private firms such as Cerebras, SambaNova Systems, PsiQuantum, Etched, and Tenstorrent.

The Stage-Progression method is the sole applicable triangulation approach. Using $10.0B as a total-raised proxy baseline and applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier yields $25.0B. The Peer-Median method was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow peer set; while 11 same-sector peers exist, none of the filtered cohorts returned the required minimum of 3 datapoints.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $21.2B (low) to $28.7B (high), with a median of $25.0B. This estimate rests on a single method and therefore carries meaningful uncertainty. Key dependencies include the validity of the $10.0B baseline proxy relative to actual revenue or user traction, the appropriateness of the 2.5x step-up multiplier for this specific company, and structural shifts in comparable company valuations. Investors should seek additional qualitative validation around technology differentiation and market timing before placing material weight on this range.
